newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PEARCE AGREES TO BE CARETAKER FOREST MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PEARCE AGREES TO BE CARETAKER FOREST MANAGER.

text.p: Stuart Pearce accepted Nottingham Forest's offer to become caretaker-manager of the English premier league club on Friday - but only until mid-January.
After pondering the situation overnight, the England and Forest defender agreed to take his first step into management and succeed Frank Clark, who resigned on Thursday.
The 34-year-old left fullback will need all the qualities he shows as a player to help save Forest, last in the league and unsettled by takeover speculation, from relegation to division one.
He faces a tough start with a home match against the league's second-placed team Arsenal at the City Ground on Saturday.
